```{r KEGG}

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

pkgs <- c("dplyr", "clusterProfiler", "org.Hs.eg.db", "AnnotationDbi", "readr")

for (pkg in pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = TRUE)
  }
}

library(dplyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(readr)



INPUT_DIR  <- "data/MOFA_RNA_Anno"
OUTDIR     <- "data/MOFA_RNA_Anno"

dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

annotated_file <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Annotated_RNA_Features.csv")

if (!file.exists(annotated_file)) {
  stop(paste("Input file not found:", annotated_file, 
             "\nPlease run RNA_annotation.Rmd first."))
}

rna_df <- read.csv(annotated_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

factors <- unique(rna_df$Factor)
cat("Found", length(factors), "factors to process for KEGG analysis.\n\n")

all_kegg_results <- list()

for (f in factors) {
  
  cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
  cat("Processing KEGG for Factor:", f, "\n")
  
  factor_dir <- file.path(OUTDIR, f)
  dir.create(factor_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  tmp <- rna_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Factor == f) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(Raw_Weight))) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 500)
  
  genes <- unique(tmp$ENTREZID)
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes) & genes != ""]
  
  if (length(genes) < 10) {
    cat("Skipping", f, "- less than 10 valid Entrez IDs found.\n")
    next
  }
  
  cat("Running enrichKEGG on", length(genes), "genes...\n")
  
  kegg_res <- tryCatch({
    enrichKEGG(
      gene          = genes,
      organism      = "hsa",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error running KEGG for", f, ":", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(kegg_res)) next
  
  kegg_res <- tryCatch({
    setReadable(kegg_res, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(kegg_res)
  })
  
  kegg_df <- as.data.frame(kegg_res)
  
  if (nrow(kegg_df) == 0) {
    cat("No pathways found for", f, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  kegg_df$Factor <- f
  
  write.csv(
    kegg_df,
    file.path(factor_dir, paste0(f, "_KEGG_All.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  sig_kegg <- kegg_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05)
  
  if (nrow(sig_kegg) > 0) {
    cat("Found", nrow(sig_kegg), "significant KEGG pathways (FDR < 0.05).\n")
    
    write.csv(
      sig_kegg,
      file.path(factor_dir, paste0(f, "_KEGG_Significant.csv")),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    
    all_kegg_results[[f]] <- sig_kegg
  } else {
    cat("No significant KEGG pathways (FDR < 0.05) found for", f, "\n")
  }
}

if (length(all_kegg_results) > 0) {
  
  combined_kegg <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_kegg_results)
  
  combined_kegg$Score <- -log10(combined_kegg$p.adjust)
  
  combined_kegg <- combined_kegg %>%
    dplyr::select(Factor, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, 
                  pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue, Score, geneID, Count)
  
  write.csv(
    combined_kegg,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "All_Factors_Significant_KEGG.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  top_kegg_per_factor <- combined_kegg %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Factor) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  write.csv(
    top_kegg_per_factor,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "Top_KEGG_Pathway_Per_Factor.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("KEGG Analysis Complete!\n")
  cat("Combined results saved to:", file.path(OUTDIR, "All_Factors_Significant_KEGG.csv"), "\n")
  cat("Top pathway per factor saved to:", file.path(OUTDIR, "Top_KEGG_Pathway_Per_Factor.csv"), "\n")
  
} else {
  cat("Finished analysis: No KEGG pathways met the FDR < 0.05 cutoff across any factor.\n")
}
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
